annotations.title: List the parts of a product

description: The flat parts list of one product in source order: assembly, part, function, material (and material id), form, finish, standard, part number, supplier, part specs, quote and source. Use it when you need the parts and not the whole record, for example "the thermal control parts of Parker Solar Probe" (part_function thermal control) or "which parts of Falcon 9 are aluminium" (material). Accepts an id, title or alias. An empty list means no such parts were published in the sources read.

material.description: Only parts of this material id, for example aluminium-2219

part_function.description: Part function: structure, thermal control, power, propulsion, mechanisms, avionics, optics, protection or other. DERIVED by explicit name rules from the part names (marked function_basis "derived"), not stated by the sources.
